newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on weak cash markets.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on weak cash markets.

text.p: Weak cash markets, especially a lower tone in Asian markets including the benchmark Thai price, pressed CBOT rice futures to a lower close, traders said.
"There were unconfirmed reports the Thai rice is now at $318.00 per tonne, down from $325.00 to $328.00 earlier in the week," a trader said.
Traders also said the excellent harvest this year of U.S. rice continued to weigh on prices.
Rice closed five to eight cents per cwt lower, with November down seven at $9.71.
